title: ABNB independent thesis validation
subtitle: 14 September 2026 | Frozen September evidence | Research horizon: 3-12 months | Local review package
lead: Retain the existing fixed kernel as a benchmark. An actionable guide-surprise or trading edge remains unestablished. The new early-origin forecast fails its preregistered hurdle. The correctly defined revenue gap is small, and the earnings-to-value result depends on unvalidated persistence and valuation assumptions.
rows: Guide RMSE: kernel $63.4m / $63.7m; direct guide-growth baseline $74.3m / $60.8m. Matched W1/W2 n=12/10. Year-removal stability also fails.
Forecast hurdle FAIL. It does beat the revenue-growth baseline in both windows.
L4 Q4 revenue $3,179.344m versus captured LSEG-family revenue $3,161.021m: +$18.322m (+0.580%). Own guide is $3,123.419m.
Explicit guide expectations unavailable. Guide minus revenue consensus is not guide surprise.
The LSEG revenue gap disappears with Q3 GBV -0.878% or Q4 conversion -0.0694pp, changing one input at a time.
Conditional boundaries, not probabilities. Physical cohort shares remain unidentified.
A Q4-only gap gives about -$0.001 to +$0.031/share at 12 months with fixed SBC. Extending the same fraction through FY27 gives $0.008-$2.771/share.
Larger value requires unvalidated persistence. Cash-cost responses are scenarios.
Using December 2027 balances prematurely adds $1.80/share versus a conditional 12-month cash/share roll. One EBITDA multiple turn changes value by $10.03/share.
Convention sensitivities dominate the isolated gap. No target or multiple is adopted.

sections.heading: What survives and what remains unknown
sections.text: The fixed conversion rule survives the earlier failed free-weight promotion test. Exact recognition shares, RNPL revenue leakage, future FX/hedge attribution and explicit guide expectations remain unidentified. Earlier executable-return evidence is inconclusive; the consensus-revision test failed. Source precision and correct accounting do not repair those missing links.

sections.heading: What would change the conclusion
sections.text: Observe Q3 GBV and the first Q4 guide against dated expectations, then test whether any revenue difference persists into later quarters. Require disclosed costs, corporate cash, buyback execution and dilution to support the financial bridge. A guide-cushion change alone changes no actual earnings or cash. The planned November catalyst date remains a project-calendar assumption.

sections.heading: Limits on permitted use
sections.text: This is a frozen-panel historical reconstruction, not an archived forecast record or untouched holdout. Origins are quarter start minus 18 days, rolled to a US session close. W1 spans 2023Q1-2026Q2; nested W2 spans 2024Q1-2026Q2. W1 has two abstentions. Midpoint +/-$0.5m is a scoring convention; raw errors give the same verdict. Scenarios carry no calibrated probabilities. No current-price recommendation, production replacement or trade adoption follows.

Exact commits, hashes, source limitations and independent review receipts accompany the handoff.
